html:
.workbench {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  container: style-workbench / inline-size;
}
.toolbar {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  padding-bottom: 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.toolbar > div {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}
.toolbar > div:first-child {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 12px;
}
.body {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 264px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 24px;
  padding-top: 20px;
}
.controls {
  min-width: 0;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding-right: 20px;
}
.sectionNav {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 4px;
  padding-bottom: 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.sectionNav button {
  min-height: var(--control-height);
  padding: 4px 8px;
  border-radius: var(--control-radius);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 13px;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.sectionNav button:hover {
  background: var(--surface-hover);
}
.sectionNav button[aria-pressed="true"] {
  background: var(--selection);
  color: var(--primary);
}
.fields {
  display: grid;
  gap: 16px;
  padding-block: 20px;
}
.numberControl {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
}
.numberControl > div {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.numberControl > div:first-child {
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 13px;
}
.numberControl > div:first-child > span {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.numberControl input[type="range"] {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 32px;
  accent-color: var(--primary);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.numberControl input[type="number"] {
  width: 64px;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  padding-inline: 4px;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 12px;
  appearance: textfield;
}
.numberControl input[type="number"]::-webkit-inner-spin-button {
  appearance: none;
}
.numberControl > div:last-child > span {
  width: 16px;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.colorControl {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 13px;
}
.colorControl > span {
  flex: 1;
}
.colorControl input {
  width: 40px;
  padding: 4px;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.colorControl code {
  width: 64px;
  font-size: 12px;
}
.checks {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 16px;
}
.checks label {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  min-height: 32px;
  font-size: 13px;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.checks input {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  accent-color: var(--primary);
}
.presets {
  padding-top: 16px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.presets h3 {
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.presets > div {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
}
.presets p {
  margin-top: 12px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 20px;
}
.results {
  display: grid;
  gap: 20px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.comparison {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 16px;
}
.previewPane {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-width: 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.previewPane > header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
  min-height: 40px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  background: var(--surface);
  font-size: 13px;
}
.previewPane > header > span:last-child {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 12px;
}
.stage {
  position: relative;
  flex: 1;
  isolation: isolate;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 400px;
  padding: 40px 24px;
  overflow: auto;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    var(--surface-raised) 0,
    var(--surface-raised) 16px,
    var(--background) 16px,
    var(--background) 32px
  );
}
.backdropMark {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: -1;
  inset: 24px;
  overflow: hidden;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: 32px;
  line-height: 64px;
  font-weight: 600;
  opacity: 0.4;
  user-select: none;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.sample {
  --lab-padding: 16px;
  --lab-gap: 12px;
  --lab-border-width: 1px;
  --lab-font-size: 14px;
  --lab-line-height: 20px;
  --lab-font-weight: 400;
  --lab-shadow: var(--shadow-floating);
  --lab-backdrop-blur: 0px;
  display: grid;
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: var(--lab-padding);
  gap: var(--lab-gap);
  border: var(--lab-border-width) solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--control-radius);
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--foreground);
  font-size: var(--lab-font-size);
  line-height: var(--lab-line-height);
  font-weight: var(--lab-font-weight);
  box-shadow: var(--lab-shadow);
  backdrop-filter: blur(var(--lab-backdrop-blur));
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.sample :where(button, input) {
  font-size: var(--lab-font-size);
  line-height: var(--lab-line-height);
  font-weight: var(--lab-font-weight);
  border-width: var(--lab-border-width);
}
.probe {
  position: absolute;
  visibility: hidden;
  pointer-events: none;
  width: 320px;
  height: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.sampleHeading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--lab-gap);
  font-weight: 500;
}
.sample p {
  margin: 0;
}
.sampleRows {
  display: grid;
}
.sampleRows > div {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--lab-gap);
  padding-block: 8px;
  border-bottom: var(--lab-border-width) solid var(--border);
}
.sampleRows > div > span:last-child {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.sampleField {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--lab-gap);
}
.sampleField label {
  font-size: 12px;
}
.sampleActions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--lab-gap);
}
.differences,
.export {
  min-width: 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--surface);
}
.differences h3 {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.differences h3 span {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-weight: 400;
}
.differences > p {
  padding: 16px 12px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 20px;
}
.tableScroll {
  overflow-x: auto;
  max-height: 240px;
}
.differences table {
  width: 100%;
  text-align: left;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 20px;
}
.differences th,
.differences td {
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-weight: 400;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.differences thead {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  background: var(--surface-raised);
}
.differences tbody tr:last-child > * {
  border-bottom: 0;
}
.differences td:last-child {
  color: var(--primary);
}
.export > div {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.export > div > div {
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
}
.export pre {
  max-height: 240px;
  padding: 16px;
  overflow: auto;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 20px;
  background: var(--background);
}
.feedback {
  min-height: 20px;
  margin-top: 12px;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 20px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
@container style-workbench (max-width: 1000px) {
  .body {
    grid-template-columns: 224px minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 16px;
  }
  .controls {
    padding-right: 16px;
  }
  .comparison {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .stage {
    min-height: 360px;
  }
}
@container style-workbench (max-width: 639px) {
  .body {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .controls {
    padding-right: 0;
    border-right: 0;
  }
  .sectionNav {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
  .sectionNav button {
    padding-inline: 4px;
    font-size: 12px;
  }
  .fields {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 16px 12px;
  }
  .checks {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }
  .colorControl {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .colorControl > span {
    flex-basis: 100%;
  }
  .presets {
    padding-bottom: 16px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .numberControl input[type="number"] {
    width: 48px;
  }
  .stage {
    padding: 32px 20px;
  }
  .comparison {
    gap: 12px;
  }
  .toolbar > div:last-child {
    gap: 4px;
  }
}
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .sectionNav button,
  .checks label,
  .numberControl input[type="range"] {
    min-height: var(--touch-target);
  }
  .colorControl input {
    width: var(--touch-target);
  }
}
